senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נָהַם)to shout, esp. to bray.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:9">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>חמור נוֹהֵק והוא וכ׳</he> when the ass brayed, he (Solomon) knew what his braying meant; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:1">Koh. R. to I, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 175">Yalk. Kings 175</cite>.
